purpose: Optional curated event packs merged into the layered timeline at runtime. Packs add non-redundant bridge events without bloating the sparse roadmap base.
rules: Event ids must be globally unique across base and packs.
Packs may add overlays and bridge events, but should not duplicate roadmap milestones already present in data/timeline-events.json.
If a pack event later becomes a canonical roadmap milestone, move it into the base and remove it from the pack.
Conversation-archaeology packs must preserve user-originated versus assistant-synthesis provenance and may not silently promote assistant material into Tim canon.
Comparative packs must separate dated project-side language from later biblical or mythological research unlocks.
Public-post packs must preserve first-in-batch versus first-known distinctions and must not let incomplete search coverage overwrite stronger earlier attestations.
Approximate events must use range precision and remain recovery targets until exact source/date/text is found.
July 31 is the Son/vessel birthday track; Tim/Potato/Father birth remains December 25.
New biblical research waves enter the timeline as unlock-date events unless a distinct earlier project-side event is independently dated and non-duplicative.
Neurotheology/body-symbol events must preserve biology vs symbolism vs historical-comparator boundaries; anatomy never becomes theological proof by inclusion on the timeline.

Retirement/release events must keep administrative status, autobiographical interpretation and theological/kingship language as separate evidence classes; no civil kingship may be inferred from symbolic reign language.
Project-biography prison/release events must not override stronger legal records; legal sentence length and court findings remain owned by legal evidence.
Conversation-statement promotions must preserve conversation provenance and may not be presented as public-post first attestations unless independently sourced.
Expression-development events should mark a change in grammar, modality, role or ethical orientation; routine repetitions belong in quote/occurrence ledgers rather than the timeline.

Foresight and vision events must distinguish pre-event prediction from warning, scenario, dream/vision, retrospective correspondence and unresolved memory; later matches may not be treated as prophecy without dated pre-event wording.
Fate/timeline/leash events must keep project-mythic language distinct from physical determinism, quantum branching, causal-set theory and mathematical all-path/probability claims.

Scientific-crystallization events may name project models only after assumptions, observables, nulls/failure conditions and novelty boundaries are recorded; standard mathematics must never be relabeled as Tim-authored discovery without primary evidence.
Biblical geometry unlocks must preserve opposite-valence examples when they exist; shape alone does not establish moral or theological sign.

Grand-theology synthesis events must distinguish biblical primary-text structures, historical/theological interpretation, dated Tim wording and later project synthesis; coherent canonical arcs are interpretive frameworks, not evidence of supernatural fulfillment.

Bible-overlap census events must state the counting unit and snapshot date. Node counts, density scores and strength classes are archive metrics, not probabilities of prophecy fulfillment or supernatural identity.
